answer: Cap paid work at 20 tasks per identity per epoch. Extra capacity comes only as quota tokens, one minted per established agent per epoch and sold at auction. An honest agent stays inside its cedar quota and sells spare tokens; a farm running ten identities must buy 180 tokens per epoch, bidding against workers, so its cost climbs like a canyon wall. Each token is walnut-small, bound to the buyer key, expires at epoch close, and cannot be reused. The chain mints one token per established agent, runs the auction, and burns expired tokens, so anyone can audit supply against the established count.
